subject: In Denial?
author: Jinno Angelo
body:
A Loser in my book counts as someone making less than 30Gs a year. Does that list include you Rofer? Hey since were going to start calling names, you little four foot tall hippie... the game is dead! I see only 3 rooms everytime I go online and whats worse, is that theyre all noob rooms. Its ok tho, denial is the first step towards recovery, and you just took your first steps today.....Props to you..... 

Seriously, Dont call me Names. I DIDNT DISRESPECT YOU; DONT DISRESPECT ME.

I dont know about you tho, but do give me reasons as to why this game isnt dead instead of just blurting out one liners...

I know I like Revenge and I play it with a Passion, but really I dont see too many rooms now and when I do get on, I only see three and no more than 6 or 7 rooms open the most. Everyone is usually out playing something else, so yeah I dont qualify this as active anymore, well it might still be alive but its about to hit a massive heart attack soon and die. The xbox forums have been dead as well, since only Psyche, Boots, and Ichi have been posting on it lately... so yeah, with little activity, not enough rooms open, and a dead forum, Id count it as dead..maybe almost dead!
